title: Setup attribution prevents Unicode format characters from spoofing rendered receipts
outcome: Setup attribution prevents Unicode format characters from spoofing rendered receipts
acceptance: Setup attribution has an explicit validation or rendering policy for Unicode format, separator and private-use characters that prevents misleading rendered receipts while preserving recorded attribution provenance.

Regression coverage includes bidi override U+202E, zero-width U+200B and line separator U+2028 alongside valid attribution; the policy covers actor context and the sibling setup attribution fields consistently.
